module.name: Provisioner
module.changelog: *1.4.59* Leaves module registration and version state to Module Admin, avoiding duplicate rows on FreePBX 16 fresh installs. Official hooks consolidate duplicates from older installers without removing the final registration or provisioning data. Includes the MariaDB 5.5/Python 3.6 compatibility fixes from 1.4.58. *1.4.58* Fixes official install/upgrade constant SELECT statements for MariaDB 5.5 while retaining SQLite test compatibility and repeat-install ownership preservation. Supports Python 3.6 subprocess arguments in optional ARP enrichment and single-IP /32 SIP searches. Validates FreePBX 16 XML migrations and rollout fixtures against isolated MariaDB 5.5. No database reset, OS package installation or change to push identity requirements. *1.4.57* Simplifies report stages and recovery with evidence-based identity labels, five-stage phone details, short history IDs and mapping return navigation. Adds Phone Status-style report Live Updates controls with independent pause/resume and bounded reconnection backoff; pausing observation never pauses provisioning. Shares mapping-grid requests and preserves selections and search context during report navigation. Adds slow-request browser regression coverage. *1.4.56* Fixes Activity Logs tab refreshes aborting overlapping table requests and triggering FreePBX AJAX errors. Loads the table on demand and shares in-flight log reads without disabling global error reporting. Genuine failures show an explicit retry control. Includes a real-browser slow-request and failure/recovery regression fixture. *1.4.55* Aligns Logs sub-tabs with Bulk Handler tab styling, spacing and section headings. Activity Logs and Batch Reports share the same content gutter and tab underline. Preserves report navigation, polling, recovery and existing log controls. *1.4.54* Moves Batch Reports from Bulk Handler to Logs alongside Activity Logs, preserving report links, polling and recovery navigation. Includes the revised report overview, stage drill-downs and phone details. Removes the Config Files Delete All button and shortens MAC Mapping Delete Mappings to Delete. Preserves selections, saved history and push safety requirements. *1.4.53* Moves wave size, post-download wait and approved automatic search networks into collapsed Advanced settings. Report Set Search Range opens the advanced section directly. Preserves saved settings, defaults and explicit search approval. *1.4.52* Simplifies rollout settings with clearer wave-size, post-download pause and automatic-search labels and examples. Distinguishes the settling pause from the verification timeout and known-IP lookup from wider approved searches. Removes non-actionable ARP availability notices without changing local push rules, wave limits, defaults or identity requirements. *1.4.51* Adds automatic routed-phone identity preflight inside Push Config: existing evidence is reused, known SIP endpoints are tried first, and wider searches use only explicitly approved ranges. Matching handset MACs remain mandatory across subnets; conflicts stop before delivery. Adds visible lookup stages and range/retry recovery. Local active ARP is optional best-effort enrichment with unchanged push requirements. Hooks check for existing ARP tooling only; no OS packages, sudoers or capabilities are changed. Preserves registration port and transport for targeting. *1.4.50* Keeps MAC Mapping focused on scoped Push Config instead of substituting Discover Phones. Improves Batch Reports with inline result reasons and next steps, confirmed-target labels, scoped Discovery actions and return navigation, compact recovery instructions, and separate delivery retries. Preserves Details, report history, selections, identity gates and explicit user control of scans, identification and pushes. *1.4.49* Prevents manual Verify Last Push from racing an active rollout or verification worker. Serializes manual verification with queue submission through the database control lock, protects swap partners, and disables the diagnostic action with explanatory guidance until automatic verification finishes. Preserves report and handset state when a stale browser attempts the action. *1.4.48* Resolves the Asterisk CLI through supported absolute paths instead of relying on Cron PATH. Fixes queued rollout registration/MAC verification under the PBX service user without changing crontab or host environment. Applies the same resolution to transport inspection, diagnostic version reporting and existing reboot fallbacks. *1.4.47* Queues complete provisioning workflows durably with bounded verified waves, duplicate and overlap protection, conservative crash recovery, shared download observation, and saved report progress. Installs database migrations and the rollout scheduler through official module hooks. Preserves swap groups, custom configs, handset identity checks and pending changes when finalization is superseded. Adds bounded explicit MAC identification batches. Validated with isolated 300-phone fixtures and MariaDB integration; physical mass-deployment capacity remains unvalidated. *1.4.46* Routes missing-target pushes to Device Discovery instead of futile retries, preserving separately scoped delivery retries for mixed results. Improves diagnostic labels and firmware visibility and adds an allowlisted copyable diagnostic summary with HTTP clipboard fallback. Keeps MAC checks and action selections intact. *1.4.45* Adds an explicit PBX callback-access self-test and Identify MAC preflight with specific HTTP access guidance. Distinguishes SIP rejection/no reply, callback timeouts, and rejected identity signatures; shows selected identification outcomes and next steps without treating job completion as success. Preserves MAC validation and read-only scans. *1.4.44* Removes the force-push-without-MAC-confirmation option and restores mandatory matching identity for routed pushes, including bulk and retries. Retires saved overrides through official install/upgrade hooks and retains the Apache callback installation fix. *1.4.43* Restores the module-scoped discovery receiver Apache access rule through official FreePBX install/upgrade hooks, including when Module Admin drops dotfiles. Keeps core access rules and handset identity validation unchanged. *1.4.42* Adds a default-off force-push-without-MAC-confirmation setting for selected, bulk, pending, and retry pushes. Shows an active warning, logs unverified targets, preserves known MAC conflict blocks, and keeps final handset verification unchanged. *1.4.41* Provisions PBX DND and call-forward enable/disable feature codes for Digium A-series and Alcatel/ALE phones, respecting customized and disabled PBX codes without setting handset feature state or forwarding destinations. *1.4.40* Standardizes action buttons and import completion, simplifies Reports into searchable history and compact phone details, and preserves report filters, pages, sorting, and expanded details during live updates. Adds narrow-screen report cards and full-history search. *1.4.39* Makes report actions clearer and changes report details to a responsive, searchable, paginated table for large batches. *1.4.38* Normalizes Reports-tab button sizing, spacing, icon alignment, and button treatment with the rest of the module. *1.4.37* Simplifies the saved-import result and aligns Batch Reports with the module’s compact controls, summary tiles, status badges, and readable report tables. *1.4.36* Moves Bulk Handler import review into a readable, scrollable modal with clear validation totals, filtering, and an explicit Save mappings action. *1.4.35* Closes the simplified Bulk Handler tab before the Provisioning and Discovery tabs so their content no longer appears under Bulk Handler. *1.4.34* Combines push/retry and reboot actions into scoped controls, gives Diagnostics a full-width wrapping push timeline, and simplifies Bulk Handler navigation and panels. *1.4.33* Aligns Phone Status actions in a consistent toolbar and keeps Latest Push details and IP evidence inside a responsive, wrapping panel. *1.4.32* Improves diagnostic push-stage spacing and makes Push Config badge counts follow the selected phones. *1.4.31* Removes the redundant Phone Status Refresh button; live updates remain primary and returning to the tab refreshes when live updates are paused. *1.4.30* Streamlines the Phone Status, import review, batch reports, and discovery screens with compact summaries, dropdown filters, and collapsible secondary details. *1.4.29* Refines Phone Status with separate registration/push filters and direct actions; adds an explicit three-step CSV review/save flow, readable batch progress and CSV downloads; clarifies scan coverage and exclusions; and organizes diagnostics around phone identity, push target, and latest outcome. *1.4.28* Adds validated CSV import previews with atomic saves, extension-swap and target-readiness checks, and persistent per-phone bulk push reports with linked retries and background verification results. *1.4.27* Restores the three-pass ping/ARP sweep for directly connected discovery ranges, supplements local MAC identities with SIP model/firmware information, retains routed SIP discovery and explicit MAC identification, and shows separate local sweep and SIP probe progress. *1.4.26* Adds read-only routed-subnet SIP OPTIONS discovery for Digium and Alcatel/ALE, explicit selected-IP Identify MAC through an isolated HTTP 404 receiver, persistent MAC/IP evidence for Bulk Handler mappings, and mandatory matching handset identity before cross-subnet pushes or retries. *1.4.25* Adds event-driven Phone Status Live Updates through a shared Asterisk listener and authenticated SSE; fixes initial control visibility, remembers preferences, preserves table state, and reconnects with recovery synchronization. *1.4.24* Shows the saved DHCP/static configuration mode beneath each IP in Phone Status, with pending-change labels and an explanatory tooltip. *1.4.23* Completes the push modal after config delivery and verifies registration/IP/MAC in a detached background worker; preserves atomic swap finalization and adds documented ALE IPv4 configuration keys. *1.4.22* Generates pending or missing configs before selected pushes, includes extension-swap partners automatically, preserves source addresses during edits, and clarifies registration-only routed-subnet discovery. *1.4.21* Discovers registered phones across routed subnets using SIP User-Agent MACs; verifies extension/IP swaps against the handset identity and finalizes late swap verification as a group. *1.4.20* Fixes cached file-access download detection in web pushes; reports live download/verification progress and observes mixed-brand batches together. *1.4.19* Simplifies Phone Status by moving fetch and verification details into Diagnostics. *1.4.18* Allows the ALE reboot/re-registration window to complete and adds late verification for downloads that finish after the initial wait. *1.4.17* Tracks SIP trigger, config download, and final network verification separately; does not finalize a push from SIP 200 OK alone. *1.4.16* Uses the reliable ALE M3s remote config-fetch NOTIFY after static network changes; keeps both documented and active provisioning URLs in generated XML. *1.4.15* Supplies both documented and active ALE provisioning URLs for remote configuration after static network changes. *1.4.14* Makes ALE M3s provisioning unattended: disables the Action URI confirmation prompt and uses the documented ACTION-URI Autop SIP trigger. *1.4.13* Trusts the PBX for ALE Action URI control so authenticated remote administration works. *1.4.12* Enabled ALE Action URI reception with confirmation prompts for remote M3s administration. *1.4.11* Fixed cloud phonebook brand switching so each brand's fields load independently. *1.4.10* Grouped Digium and Alcatel cloud phonebook settings behind one brand selector. *1.4.9* Added authenticated ALE M3s remote phonebook settings and documented M3s XML configuration keys. *1.4.8* Set the default Digium phonebook URL format to explicitly request Digium XML output. *1.4.7* Added configurable authenticated Digium cloud phonebook name, URL, username, and password settings. *1.4.6* Added strict brand-specific pulled-config validation. Invalid HTML, nginx responses, login pages, malformed XML, and invalid Digium/Yealink formats are rejected before saving or reporting success. *1.4.5* Config Files tab: fixed case-sensitivity bug — files with uppercase MACs now appear. Digium pull: replaced Python requests with curl (handles malformed HTTP headers from Digium phones). *1.4.4* Phone Status: "Registered" now shows before "No Config" (fixes "Add Only" showing No Config for online phones). Digium pull: fixed crash on malformed auth header during config fetch. *1.4.3* DHCP Option 66: device discovery from DHCP lease file (dnsmasq.leases). Fixed "Apply Pending" after successful push — push now clears needs_changes flag. Configurable dhcp_leases_file path in settings. *1.4.2* Removed PnP daemon (pnp_server.py, pnp-server.service), PnP discovery tab, PnP deployment mode. Only DHCP Option 66 and SIP NOTIFY modes remain. *1.4.1* Replaced DHCP Leases tab with PnP Discovered Devices. Added clearPnpDiscovery(), getArpIpByMac() helper, pnp_discovered.json logging in pnp_server.py. *1.4.0* Yealink support (template, generate method, OUI prefixes). VLAN settings (global Voice/Data VLAN ID for Alcatel/Digium/Yealink). Alcatel template rewritten with latest XML param names. Admin password injection. Reset-to-default bug fixed (.dist files synced). *1.2.0* Hybrid IP resolution — store IP from discovery, auto-resolve from ARP/nmap at push time, stored IP fallback for cross-subnet phones *1.1.0* Discovery tab with Network Scan + PnP Listener + SIP NOTIFY push (no DHCP Option 66 required) *1.0.2* Alcatel config fetch + backup/restore, bulk pull/revert, Fetch-preview modal, brand-aware file paths *1.0.1* Option 66 validation, Bulk Handler UI fixes, copy provisioning URL, AUTO_INCREMENT fix *1.0.0* Initial release
module.description: Endpoint Provisioning Manager with DHCP-independent Digium and Alcatel/ALE discovery and MAC-aware SIP provisioning across local and routed subnets.
